author: morgue
text:
v0.3.1 P3: response.json as JSONL stream + writer-closes-fd completion

The harness drives `complete` with `stream: true` and tail-writes
response.json event-by-event as JSONL of §4.4 events. The same
events are folded in-memory into the assistant blocks the next step
needs; response.json is never read back at runtime per the §2.3
diagnostic-only contract. Closing the response.json fd at terminal
message_stop / error is the §3.5 IN_CLOSE_WRITE completion signal.

AdapterRunner.run flips to a streaming line callback so describe
(one line) and complete (many) share one path. The Anthropic
adapter now forwards `partial_json` on `input_json_delta` deltas so
tool_use input survives the streaming wire end-to-end.
